parsed.title: AOL Guest Commenter
parsed.oneLiner: Allow users to post a single news comment by playing a mini-game instead of signing up.

newMechanic.name: Guest Posting
newMechanic.description: A temporary authorization to submit one comment to a news article discussion without a full AOL account registration.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The sign-up wall on the Add Comment Page (s05) prevents spontaneous interaction from guest users, losing valuable engagement data and ad opportunities.

parsed.trigger: When a user land on the Add Comment Page and encounters the Sign Up to Post requirement.
parsed.eligibility: Non-signed-in users who have entered text in the comment box.

offer.title: Post as a guest
offer.body: Don't want to sign up right now? Play a quick 15-second game to post this comment as a guest.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The guest pass is limited to a single comment per day and does not grant account benefits like comment history, replies, or profile customization, maintaining the long-term value of a full AOL account.
risks: Potential for lower-quality comments from non-verified users
User frustration if the guest post limit is hit

evidence.quote: User attempts to post a comment on an article and hits the sign-up wall.

newElements.change: A Simula 'Play to Post' rewarded invitation button styled as a secondary action.

storyboard.caption: The user reads interesting comments on a news article.
When trying to comment, they see the sign-up requirement but also a new guest option.
The user chooses to play a quick game to unlock a guest post.
The reward is verified and the user's comment is published immediately.
